# Music Recommendation Chatbot

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#music-recommendation-chatbot)

An intelligent music recommendation system powered by AI that provides personalized song suggestions through a conversational chatbot interface. The application features user feedback collection, recommendation history tracking, and a RESTful API built with Flask.

## Overview

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#overview)

This chatbot-driven music recommendation system analyzes user preferences and provides tailored music suggestions. The application includes a feedback mechanism to improve recommendations over time and maintains a comprehensive history of user interactions.

## Features

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#features)

- AI-powered music recommendations based on user input
- Interactive chatbot interface for natural conversation
- User feedback collection system for continuous improvement
- SQLite database for persistent storage of feedback and history
- RESTful API with CORS support for frontend integration
- Recommendation history tracking
- Real-time song suggestions based on mood, genre, or artist preferences

## Technology Stack

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#technology-stack)

- **Backend Framework**: Flask
- **Database**: SQLite
- **Machine Learning**: Custom recommendation model
- **CORS Support**: Flask-CORS for cross-origin requests
- **Language**: Python 3.x

## Installation

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#installation)

### Prerequisites

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#prerequisites)

- Python 3.7 or higher
- pip package manager

### Setup Instructions

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#setup-instructions)

1. Clone the repository:

```shell
git clone https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot.git
cd Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot
```

2. Install required dependencies:

```shell
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

Required packages:

- Flask
- flask-cors
- sqlite3 (included in Python standard library)
- Additional dependencies listed in requirements.txt

3. Initialize the application:

```shell
python app.py
```

4. The server will start on `http://localhost:5000` by default

## API Endpoints

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#api-endpoints)

### 1. Get Music Recommendations

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#1-get-music-recommendations)

**Endpoint**: `/recommend`

**Method**: `POST`

**Request Body**:

```json
{
  "input": "upbeat pop songs"
}
```

**Response**:

```json
{
  "recommendations": [
    "Song 1",
    "Song 2",
    "Song 3"
  ]
}
```

**Description**: Accepts user input describing music preferences and returns a list of recommended songs.

### 2. Submit Feedback

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#2-submit-feedback)

**Endpoint**: `/feedback`

**Method**: `POST`

**Request Body**:

```json
{
  "song": "Song Title",
  "feedback": "loved it"
}
```

**Response**:

```json
{
  "message": "Feedback saved successfully!"
}
```

**Error Response** (400):

```json
{
  "error": "Song and feedback are required"
}
```

**Description**: Allows users to provide feedback on recommended songs for system improvement.

### 3. View Feedback History

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#3-view-feedback-history)

**Endpoint**: `/history`

**Method**: `GET`

**Response**:

```json
{
  "history": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "song": "Song Title",
      "feedback": "loved it"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Description**: Retrieves all stored user feedback and recommendation history.

## Usage Examples

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#usage-examples)

### Making a Recommendation Request

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#making-a-recommendation-request)

```python
import requests

url = "http://localhost:5000/recommend"
data = {"input": "relaxing jazz music"}

response = requests.post(url, json=data)
print(response.json())
```

### Submitting Feedback

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#submitting-feedback)

```python
import requests

url = "http://localhost:5000/feedback"
data = {
    "song": "Blue in Green",
    "feedback": "Perfect for studying"
}

response = requests.post(url, json=data)
print(response.json())
```

### Retrieving History

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#retrieving-history)

```python
import requests

url = "http://localhost:5000/history"
response = requests.get(url)
print(response.json())
```

## Recommendation Model

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#recommendation-model)

The recommendation system analyzes user input using natural language processing and machine learning techniques to suggest relevant songs. The model considers:

- User-provided mood or genre keywords
- Artist preferences
- Previous feedback patterns
- Musical characteristics and attributes

Details of the recommendation algorithm can be found in `recommendation_model.py`.

## Configuration

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#configuration)

The application uses the following default settings:

- **Debug Mode**: Enabled (should be disabled in production)
- **Host**: localhost
- **Port**: 5000
- **Database Path**: `database/db.sqlite`

To modify these settings, edit the configuration in `app.py`.

## Development

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#development)

### Running in Development Mode

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#running-in-development-mode)

```shell
python app.py
```

The application will run with debug mode enabled, providing detailed error messages and automatic reloading on code changes.

### Running in Production

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#running-in-production)

For production deployment:

1. Disable debug mode in `app.py`
2. Use a production WSGI server like Gunicorn:

```shell
gunicorn -w 4 app:app
```

## Frontend Integration

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Music--Recommendation-using-chatbot#frontend-integration)

The API is CORS-enabled and can be integrated with any frontend framework:

- React
- Vue.js
- Angular
- Plain HTML/JavaScript

Example frontend fetch request:

```js
fetch('http://localhost:5000/recommend', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'energetic workout music' })
})
.then(response => response.json())
.then(data => console.log(data.recommendations));
```

## About

DePad is a decentralized, censorship-resistant public notepad protocol that lets anyone create, share, and permanently publish text using only a URL. It replaces centralized servers with blockchain smart contracts and IPFS to provide immutable, verifiable, owner-controlled public documents.

# Instant Canteen

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Canteen-Management-Application#instant-canteen)

## Project Overview

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Canteen-Management-Application#project-overview)

**Instant Canteen** is a modern web application designed to simplify payments and ordering prior at campus canteens and shops.Studnets can place orders from their phone during class hours and enjoy their orders while skipping long queues during peak rush hours like short break and lunch break, students use their mobile phones to scan a UPI QR code and pay instantly, eliminating the need for cash and providing a seamless transaction experience for both students and vendors.

The ablity of Staff (canteen owners) to receive orders before rush hours allows them to prepare these orders and increase the overall sales that happen during the break time while also reducing the waiting time for students this coupled futher with a Staff dashboard allows them to dynamically change menu items,track and process orders.

This project is built with a focus on a clean user interface, security, and performance.

## Visit now ~ [https://instantcanteen.netlify.app](https://instantcanteen.netlify.app/)

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Canteen-Management-Application#visit-now--httpsinstantcanteennetlifyapp)

## Key Features

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Canteen-Management-Application#key-features)

- **Quick Scan & Pay:** Instantly scan UPI QR codes to initiate payments.
- **Intuitive UI:** A user-friendly interface optimized for mobile devices.
- **Vendor Dashboard:** A separate dashboard for canteen owners to manage their details and update their UPI QR code.
- **Transaction History:** (Future Feature) View a history of all payments made.

## Technologies Used

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Canteen-Management-Application#technologies-used)

- **Frontend:** React, TypeScript
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS
- **Build Tool:** Vite
- **Database & Auth:** Supabase (for user authentication and data management)

## Getting Started

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Canteen-Management-Application#getting-started)

### Prerequisites

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Canteen-Management-Application#prerequisites)

- Node.js (v18 or higher)
- npm

### Installation and Setup

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Canteen-Management-Application#installation-and-setup)

1. **Clone the repository:**
    
    ```shell
    git clone https://github.com/haris-collab/Instant_Canteen.git
    cd campus-pay-scan
    ```
    
2. **Install dependencies:**
    
    ```shell
    npm install
    ```
    
3. **Set up Environment Variables:** Create a `.env.local` file in the root of your project and add your Supabase credentials:
    
    ```
    VITE_SUPABASE_URL=YOUR_SUPABASE_URL
    VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=YOUR_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
    ```
    
4. **Run the development server:**
    
    ```shell
    npm run dev
    ```
    
    The application will be available at `http://localhost:5173`.
    

## Deployment

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Canteen-Management-Application#deployment)

This project can be easily deployed to platforms like Vercel, Netlify, or AWS Amplify.

### Example: Vercel

[](https://github.com/jeevanu345/Canteen-Management-Application#example-vercel)

1. Push your code to a GitHub repository.
2. Log in to Vercel and import your project from Git.
3. Vercel will automatically detect the Vite setup and deploy the app.
4. Add your Supabase environment variables in the Vercel dashboard under "Settings > Environment Variables."

## About

Instant Canteen is a web app that lets students pre-order food and pay via UPI to skip queues. Staff can manage menus, track orders, and boost sales with ease.
